Four local warehouses and a central DC, each buffering for itself, hold €4.8M of safety stock. Deciding where the stock sits cuts that to €3.7M at the same fill rate.

Slow movers are 80% of items but 20% of sales. Spread over four sites, each warehouse needs its own buffer for them, €1.6M in this illustrative network. Pool them centrally, ship them next day, and keep fast movers close to customers. Same 97% fill rate, €1.1M less stock.

Then cut local trucks from daily to twice a week. Local buffers grow by half. Optimized, the network needs €4.7M. Today's setup would need €6.6M.

Where does your safety stock sit today, and who decided?

Invented numbers, real mechanics. A new planning concept every Tuesday and Thursday.
